headline: Approved a $41,867.02 contract for Beverage-Air milk coolers from Alternative Sales Corp.
summary: The meeting reviewed MCAS results and school accountability ratings. It also heard updates on the Constellations program, tutoring, and purchasing delays with the city. The only recorded vote approved a milk cooler contract.
decisions: Approved the $41,867.02 contract for Beverage-Air milk coolers through Alternative Sales Corp of Kingston, New Hampshire, 6-0 with one member absent.
discussion: MCAS results and grade 10 effort: Members discussed blank essay answers and whether an incentive could raise test effort.
Accountability and school progress: Officials reported moderate progress district-wide, growth at the grammar schools, and limited progress at the high school.
City purchasing delays: Officials discussed late contract renewals and plans for monthly check-ins with the city.
Constellations program staffing: Members asked about staff attendance and how district staff feel about covering a second classroom.
AI and writing instruction: Members asked how the district will respond to AI use in essays and math homework.
